target: one public VigilODE solver package/frontend with separate method kernels
principles: Method kernels retain separate state, coefficients and controller semantics.
One capability registry, transactional lifecycle and complete work/error authority.
No duplicate thread pools, controllers or work ledgers.
Explicit method selection first; automatic portfolio opt-in only after qualification.

modules.responsibility: Problem, SolverConfig, Solver, SolverSession, StepAttempt, StepDecision, SolutionOutput
MethodDescriptor registry and derivative/mass-matrix/event/dense-output capability predicates
attempt/accept/reject, generation tokens, epoch invalidation, atomic hidden-state commit
typed complete work/memory/time report; adapter over existing WorkCounters and fair-ab
retain existing DOPRI/RODAS/Peer kernels; no initial movement of protected sources
2D/3D/sphere MOL adapters, geometry norms and mesh/model contracts

sequence: Add typed descriptors and capability registry without route changes.
Wrap a qualified method with method-owned opaque state.
Add transactional lifecycle and rollback tests.
Expose explicit method selection and legacy adapter.
Add opt-in portfolio only after history/error transfer certificate.
forbidden_shortcuts: Flatten all method histories into indistinguishable shared state.
Route defaults to opt-in methods before qualification.
